title: Reconcile a late Codex turn-start response against an adopted explicit start without accepting a retired request's terminal
outcome: An explicit start that arrives first keeps established compatibility while a late matching response can detect a mismatched adopted turn identity; a never-retired old start/terminal cannot settle a newer handshake.
acceptance: Record an architectural decision for how exact RPC identity reconciliation preserves valid explicit-start-before-response and fully idless compatibility.
Cover a delayed old explicit start plus terminal absent from the retired cache, with a later response identifying the newer turn; no wrong receipt settlement or provider dispatch occurs.
Retain normal response-first and valid explicit-start-first operation.
